title: IB MTS Tier-II Admit Card 2026
organization: Intelligence Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs
vacancyDetails: Tier-II admit card for IB MTS candidates shortlisted after Tier-I
qualification: Matriculation / 10th pass as per IB MTS notification
ageLimit: 18 to 25 years (as per IB MTS rules; relaxations apply)
documentsRequired: Registration credentials; printed Tier-II admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit official MHA / IB recruitment portal (as linked in Tier-I notice)
2. Open IB MTS Tier-II Admit Card login
3. Enter registration number and password/DOB
4. Download and print hall ticket
5. Appear for Tier-II descriptive exam as scheduled
shortDescription: IB MTS Tier-II Admit Card 2026 – download hall ticket from official IB/MHA recruitment portal for candidates shortlisted after Tier-I.
content:
The Intelligence Bureau (IB) under the Ministry of Home Affairs conducts Multi-Tasking Staff recruitment in tiers. Tier-II Admit Card is issued to candidates shortlisted from Tier-I CBT.

Candidates must download the hall ticket only from the official recruitment website mentioned in the employment news / MHA notice, verify exam centre details, and carry printed admit card with original photo ID.
